title: Count Commas in Range
summary: Given an integer n, calculate the total number of commas used in the standard number formatting of all integers from 1 to n, where commas are placed after every three digits from the right, and no commas are used in numbers with fewer than four digits.
statement: Given an integer n, calculate the total number of commas used in the standard number formatting of all integers from 1 to n, where commas are placed after every three digits from the right, and no commas are used in numbers with fewer than four digits.
constraints: Format every integer from one through n with commas after each three-digit group.
Count all comma characters used across those formatted integers.
hints: Every number at least 1000 contributes its first comma.
Every number at least one million contributes one additional comma, and so on by factors of 1000.
At a threshold t, exactly n-t+1 values contribute that comma.
Sum these contributions for all thresholds no greater than n.
editorial: Sum these contributions for all thresholds no greater than n.

tests.explanation: Numbers 1000, 1001, and 1002 each use one comma, totaling three.
No number through 999 uses a comma.
